Actor Dhanush's potential political entry sparks speculation in Tamil Nadu

Speculation is mounting in Tamil Nadu about actor Dhanush potentially entering politics, following a similar buzz around actor Vijay. While Dhanush has not commented on his political ambitions, his organizational activities have fueled the discussion. Various political parties have reacted to the rumors, with the AIADMK reportedly wanting him, the TVK mocking the idea, and the Congress expressing suspicion.
